dedupe_keys.name: measured vs modelled co2 for industrial facilities eutl and epa ghgrp matched to climate trace inzonex

description: A matched table that checks modelled facility emissions against reported ones. The Zenodo record says it pairs measured facility-level CO2, verified EU ETS emissions from the EU Transaction Log and US EPA GHGRP data for reporting year 2023, with modelled asset-level estimates from Climate TRACE for industrial point sources in cement, steel, refineries, chemicals, glass, paper and food and beverage; each record gives measured and modelled annual CO2, their percentage difference and match quality. Across 711 confidently matched large sources the median difference is -1%, the median absolute difference 14%, and 64% fall within 25%. Published on 19 June 2026, it has a CSV of about 0.3 MB, a README and three figures, free to download under CC BY 4.0, with a browsable version on the Inzonex Industry Atlas. Coverage is the EU and the United States. Caveats: one year, and only facilities that could be matched. For simulation it tells modellers how far to trust satellite-based plant emissions when they stand in for plant activity levels. Related catalogue records include Climate TRACE and the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program.
